brand_name: Trak'd Service Log & Call Center Operations
tagline: Digital Service Log Sheet & Call Center Operations Platform

posts.title: Digital Service Log Sheets for Field Technicians
posts.objective: Promote digital service log sheet replacement over paper.
posts.caption: Replace messy paper service tickets with Trak'd. Log arrival times, labor hours, installed parts, and site notes instantly from your phone or tablet.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Digital service log sheet UI on tablet displaying technician arrival times and work performed notes.

posts.title: Call Center Intake & Service Call Dispatch
posts.objective: Highlight call center ticket logging and real-time dispatch.
posts.caption: Streamline customer intake from call center to field. Trak'd connects customer service reps directly to field technicians for instant service call logging.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Call center rep wearing headset with dual monitors showing active service call dispatch queues.

posts.title: Labor Hours & Personnel Arrival/Departure Logs
posts.objective: Showcase exact arrival and departure time tracking.
posts.caption: Track exact technician arrival and departure times per service call. Trak'd calculates total electrician and technician labor hours automatically.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Time log breakdown table showing tech names, arrival/departure timestamps, and hourly rates.

posts.title: Material & Parts Usage with Dynamic Markup
posts.objective: Promote itemized parts logging and automatic markup math.
posts.caption: Never miss billing for installed parts again. Trak'd logs parts used on job sites and applies dynamic company markup percentages automatically.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Parts and materials itemized list displaying unit costs, quantity, markup %, and customer price.

posts.title: On-Site Photo Documentation & Service Proof
posts.objective: Highlight photo uploads attached to service log sheets.
posts.caption: Document completed repairs with photos. Upload site images directly into Trak'd service log sheets for complete transparency and client verification.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Technician photographing electrical panel with app interface uploading photo directly to work order log.

posts.title: Vehicle Mileage & Trip Log per Service Call
posts.objective: Promote vehicle mileage tracking tied to work order numbers.
posts.caption: Log vehicle numbers and accumulated trip mileage for every service call. Trak'd links vehicle travel costs directly to customer service invoices.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Service truck on road with digital mileage counter overlay linked to Work Order #1042.

posts.title: Real-Time Job Cost Breakdown & Customer Total
posts.caption: Instantly calculate total service call costs including labor, equipment hours, materials, and mileage with Trak'd automated cost breakdown.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Estimated cost breakdown card showing labor ($), equipment ($), mileage ($), and grand total ($).

posts.title: Real-time Dispatch Sync Between Office & Field
posts.caption: Eliminate communication delays between call center reps and field techs. Trak'd updates service call status live across all devices.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Dual view showing call center desktop screen syncing in real-time with field technician tablet.

posts.title: Searchable Client Service Call Archives
posts.objective: Promote historical service log search and retrieval.
posts.caption: Need to look up a service call from 6 months ago? Search Trak'd digital archives by client name, location, or work order number in seconds.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Search bar with instant filtered list of past service calls and downloadable PDF log sheets.

posts.title: One-Click Email Log Delivery to Property Owners
posts.objective: Highlight instant automated PDF email delivery.
posts.caption: Finish the job and email a professional PDF service log sheet directly to the client before you even start the truck. Powered by Trak'd.

visual_spec.topic_visual: Professional email preview displaying 'Trak'd Log Submitted: Work Order #1084' with attached PDF log sheet.
